verdict.rationale: Postman documents and exposes a full public REST API (postman-docs-5) with an OpenAPI spec confirmed live via probe (postman-probe-3), and explicitly documents its use for CI/CD toolchain integration (postman-docs-6, postman-docs-19), plus a working CLI (postman-probe-6) for headless/programmatic control. This is independently verified hands-on (openapi.json returns valid spec, CLI runs via npx) rather than just claimed docs. Missing for 10: no independent third-party review specifically validating API completeness/coverage beyond the probes.
